new_findings_today.title: qa/_lib/build_report.js reads a different field name than findings.json actually carries for the 'K — Map widget' QA-report row, silently mis-rendering it as ATTENTION with '0/0 surfaces probed'
new_findings_today.detail: sectionResults() in qa/_lib/build_report.js computes the K row from `m.map_widget_destination_pages_with_leaflet` and `m.map_widget_destination_pages_probed_interactive`, but every findings.json on record (today's and at least 07-06's) actually populates `map_dest_pages_leaflet_template` and `map_dest_pages_probed_interactive` instead. Because the names never matched, the generator's own defaulting (`|| 0`) silently produced 'ATTENTION — Leaflet present on 0/0 surfaces probed' in the QA persona report even on days (like today, and apparently 07-06) where Leaflet was confirmed working. Caught by actually reading the generated NakshIQ_QA_Report.docx text today rather than trusting the build step's exit code. A smaller, non-verdict-flipping instance of the same class exists in the Section E detail line: `m.sos_destinations_with_local_helpers_block` is also never populated by findings.json, so that row's descriptive text has been understating the denominator (rendering '0/0 have no SOS block' instead of '0/533') without affecting the PASS/ATTENTION verdict itself.
new_findings_today.evidence: unzip -p NakshIQ_QA_Report.docx word/document.xml showed literal text 'K — Map widget (Chrome E2E) ATTENTION Leaflet present on 0/0 surfaces probed' before this run added compatibility alias fields; qa/_lib/build_report.js lines defining sectionResults()'s K row and the E row's sos_destinations_with_local_helpers_block reference.
new_findings_today.recommendation: Fix qa/_lib/build_report.js to read the field names findings.json actually uses (map_dest_pages_leaflet_template / map_dest_pages_probed_interactive, and add a real sos_destinations_with_local_helpers_block computation, e.g. destinations_total_db - sos_dests_without_emergency_sos_row_db), OR standardize findings.json going forward to emit the widget/legacy names the generator expects. As a same-day mitigation (not a code change), today's findings.json also carries map_widget_destination_pages_with_leaflet/probed_interactive and sos_destinations_with_local_helpers_block as compatibility aliases with the same real values, so today's QA report renders correctly. Low severity: report-accuracy only, no live-site impact — but worth fixing in the generator so future runs don't need the alias workaround.
